values.value: Quantity as determined independent draft survey, nominated by the seller, to govern and be final. Quality as stated on manufacturer's certificate or, at Seller's option, independent certificate of analysis to govern and be final. Draft Survey report will not be provided as part of vessel documentation. If buyer requires a draft survey report for vessel documentation purposes at destination port, then buyer may appoint an independent draft surveyor for their account. Seller will not provide a hold cleanliness certificate as part of vessel documentation.
